purpose: Define explicit side-effect classes so read, local mutation, remote mutation, lifecycle, destructive and security-sensitive operations can be gated differently.

topics.name: Operation Side-Effect Class
topics.purpose: Define explicit side-effect classes so read, local mutation, remote mutation, lifecycle, destructive and security-sensitive operations can be gated differently.

semantics.identity_rule: Side-effect class is explicit operation metadata.
semantics.authorization_rule: Different classes may require different authorization/assurance profiles.
semantics.dry_run_rule: Dry-run semantics are explicit per operation and do not imply no hidden effects unless declared.
semantics.destructive_rule: Destructive class requires exact target and explicit destructive gate.
semantics.external_rule: External effect includes actions whose effect occurs outside local canonical store.
semantics.composition_rule: Composite operation inherits the strongest relevant declared effect class unless explicit semantics say otherwise.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

prose.summary: Define explicit side-effect classes so read, local mutation, remote mutation, lifecycle, destructive and security-sensitive operations can be gated differently.
